description.fun: Komala is asleep from the day it's born to the day it dies, thanks to a sedating poison in the leaves it eats, which only Komala can break down. It eats, travels and even battles in its sleep, and its changing expressions come from its dreams. Take away the log it hugs and it thrashes about, and its diluted saliva was once used as an anaesthetic for surgery.
description.guide: Komala is a Normal-type Pokémon from Alola based on the koala. It never wakes up, thanks to sedative leaves in its diet, which its unique Comatose Ability reflects. It always clings to a log it is given at birth, and it doesn't evolve.
description.tagline: A koala that spends its whole life asleep
